items.q: What does a 100 Trying response guarantee?
choices: The next hop received the request and the UAC can stop retransmitting that INVITE
items.why: 100 Trying is hop-by-hop. It does not mean alerting or answer.

items.q: Which three values identify a SIP dialog?
choices: Call-ID, local tag, and remote tag
From display name, To display name, and date
items.why: The dialog ID is the Call-ID plus the tags. The branch identifies a transaction.

items.q: An SDP answer sets the audio port to 0. What does that mean?
items.why: Port 0 rejects the stream. It is not a request to pick a default.

items.q: G.722 audio is 16 kHz. What RTP timestamp clock rate does RFC 3551 assign it?
items.why: The RTP clock for G.722 is 8000 even though the audio bandwidth is wider. This is a classic interop bug.

items.q: A 200 OK to CANCEL means what?
choices: The CANCEL transaction succeeded; watch the INVITE for 487
items.why: CANCEL has its own transaction. The INVITE ends with a response such as 487 Request Terminated.

items.q: Which mechanism is the IETF standard for telephone events in RTP?
items.why: telephone-event is the standards-track DTMF in RTP. INFO is a generic method, not the DTMF specification.

items.q: What is an SBC in the taxonomy of RFC 7092?
choices: A back-to-back user agent with two dialogs
items.why: A signaling B2BUA terminates one dialog and creates another. Media may be anchored or not. RFC 5853 is the requirements discussion, not a wire protocol.

items.q: ICE candidate types you should be able to name are:
items.why: Host is local, server-reflexive comes from STUN, relay comes from TURN. RFC 8445 is the ICE specification.

choices: Session recording client and session recording server
items.why: The SRC is the application that has the communication session. The SRS is the recorder. Metadata is RFC 7865.

items.q: Which header carries a STIR PASSporT?
items.why: RFC 8224 defines the Identity header. SHAKEN is an ATIS profile of that work, not a different SIP method.

items.q: A call drops near 30 minutes and the traces show Session-Expires. What do you read next?
items.why: Session timers refresh a dialog with UPDATE or re-INVITE. A missing refresh ends the session.

items.q: Why is a CRM not a SIP element?
choices: Because it cannot store a phone number
Because screen pop uses data the contact center already has; it does not have to be a dialog endpoint
Because ANI is illegal to log
items.why: ANI, DNIS, and case ids may arrive in SIP or in a later CTI event. The CRM is a neighbor, not a proxy.
